title: Auto Parts Supplier for Mexico | Autologic Industries
description: Autologic Industries is an auto parts supplier for Mexico, exporting motorcycle clutch parts, mototaxi spares and aluminium castings from India.
banner_desc: Motorcycle, mototaxi and casting components exported from India for buyers in Mexico.
hero_sub: Clutch, Brake, Engine & Die Casting Parts
hero_alt: Clutch assembly from the Autologic range for Mexican buyers
hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Mexico. We export clutch systems, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings to importers, distributors and assemblers.

Motorcycles are widely used in Mexico for commuting and deliveries, and three-wheeler mototaxis provide short trips in many towns. Our parts are built to OEM-grade tolerances for that kind of daily, high-mileage use. Browse the range below. Every component is tested in our plant before it is packed, and our team can help you plan an opening range.

network.title: Why Mexican Buyers Source From Us
paras: With more than 25 years of drivetrain manufacturing and IATF 16949 certification, we test every component before dispatch.
One supplier for clutch, brake and casting lines simplifies ordering and keeps quality consistent.
We can work from your existing part numbers and samples, which helps you add our parts to your catalogue quickly.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Mexico
paras: Orders travel by sea in palletised export packing to the Mexican port you choose, with complete documents for your customs broker.
Motorcycle, mototaxi and casting items can share a container, and repeat shipments can be scheduled.
Cartons can carry your brand and part numbers for distributors who sell through several stores.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Mexican market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Mexico. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order, so you can check fit on local models.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, distributors and assemblers in Mexico. Our export team replies to enquiries with fitment notes, packing details and clear commercial terms.
faqs: Do you supply motorcycle and mototaxi parts to Mexico?
Yes. Our range covers two and three wheeler clutch parts, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings.
Can I combine product lines in one shipment?
Yes. We combine different parts in one consignment and label cartons by model.
Can you make parts to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Yes. Samples let you confirm fit and finish before volume orders.
Do your clutch plates resist heat?
Yes. Our two wheeler friction plates use a non-asbestos compound rated for up to 300°C peak continuous endurance.
Can you support an assembly programme?
Yes. Our casting and machining lines can supply drawing-based parts on a planned delivery schedule.
How are consignments documented for Mexico?
Each shipment includes the commercial invoice, packing list and other export documents your customs broker requests.
